dimension_description: This phase-one concentration scale uses molar concentration, stored canonically in moles per cubic meter. It connects trace atmospheric or biochemical concentrations with laboratory solutions and nearly pure substances. Concentration is highly definition-sensitive, so each item states what is dissolved or counted.
